notes.title: v1.41
notes.content:
Reduced lag when switching pagination between storyboards
 Items on the map are no longer bound to the UI component "Card", so you can more freely personalize their display on the map
 Added skin "equipment.png", please copy from "MushroomCardRPG_Data/StreamingAssets/template/gameSkin" to "MushroomCardRPG_Data/StreamingAssets/config/gameSkin"
 Added a "Serial" option to make group effects cast sequentially instead of at the same time
 Tab button fast-forwards not only dialogues but also the overall gameplay. Thus, its easier to skip long episodes during testing
 Combat skills are now listed in alphabetical order and no longer fluctuate due to lost/gained skills

notes.title: v1.24
notes.content:
New features


 Press P on the home page to quickly open a new save for testing
 The number of playing loops can be set for skill targets
 If the target of a skill group in self, the skill effect is "cast skill", and the target of the cast skill is a mono, then the parent skill is also considered containing a mono target. During cast, players can select the target (previously selected randomly). This means that "cast skill" can be used as a skill macro.
 You can set conditions for options. If the conditions not met, the option won't appear. 
 Triggering multiple same sound effects in a short time (0.05 seconds) will be merged into one sound effect

notes.title: v1.12

notes.title: V1.1 Combat system overhaul!
notes.content:
Introduce speed. 

 All character in the combat runs in a circular runway with a default speed of 100. 
 A character will take one action once they finish one loop.
 Passive skill with speed (you can set it in the left of the passive skill panel) can add speed to the character.
 Characters with higher speed will run faster and so act more frequently.
 If two character finish one loop at the same time, their action order will be randomized.


New skill effect: Gain extra action

 The target of this effect will gain an extra action chance.


Skill slot setting in setting panel:

 Slot count that limits the number of skills hero and hero's followers can equip. Default is ∞. If set with a number, the player can click the skill slots button to change skills in slots. 


More value options

 Gain HP, Gain MP, and Gain posture can set percentage values. For example, gain HP equals to 0.5*damage.


Other improvement

 Passive skill can hide from the player. The option is in the top right of the passive spell panel.
 Enforce 16:9 in wider screen.

notes.title: v1.08
notes.content:
Bugfix

 hp bar shifting if posture disable

New feature

 Combat system rework, Characters now act one by one in combat. The action order will be displayed in the bottom left. 

 This is because the old acting by team system causes difficulty for player to see enemies' continuous and fast actions. 
 It is also difficult to think strategies when all the skill buttons displayed for player's team. 
 If you have other ideas about this change, welcome to discuss with me in the form!

 Better damage number effect. Now they are not likely to overlay with each other.

notes.title: Mushroom Card RPG v1.1 file browser version update！
notes.content:
New features

- File browser added! click the "plus sign on the right side of the input box" to use it for file path selection.

- In the combat, the enemies' action sequence is changed to fixed, from the last one in the team to the leader, so it's easier to design the enemy's AI strategy.

- 0 damage can now trigger passive spells.

- The skill condition "Has Passive Skill" is changed to "Has Skill Or Passive".


BUG Fix

- Editor camera state cannot be saved

- Passive triggered by HP<=0 cannot play its effect

- Passive triggered by HP<=0 triggered repeatedly under near death protection

- Projectiles are not displayed in the white line track effect

- The notation of "item name * quantity" does not take effect in the Act Condition "own item"

- Change "damage multipler" to "damage buff" to prevent mis-understanding
